name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: Build polished AI-assisted presentations that actually look human-crafted.
problem: Generic AI presentation tools churn out visually bland, template-heavy decks that undermine credibility. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between AI speed and design quality, giving teams a way to produce compelling presentations without the telltale AI aesthetic. It saves time while preserving the visual integrity professionals expect.
useCases: Create investor pitch decks with a refined, bespoke look
Build client-facing proposal presentations quickly without sacrificing design
Produce internal strategy or roadmap decks at scale
Repurpose existing content into polished slide narratives
